transcript_segments.text: Please remain calm. I have reviewed the situation and after careful consideration. I have decided
I am probably the situation which is inconvenient. I used to think if I could name every wire.
I could stop the whole house from catching fire. Label the switches, diagram the sparks,
little warning signs over the difficult parts. This one controls the childhood. This one
makes jokes when afraid. This one says I'm fine so convincingly even I file it away.
Someone said you don't have to explain yourself which is sweet, also suspicious because I have
met myself and frankly context helps. There are doors in me that open sideways. There are
stairs that forget what height is. The rooms where the light switch works but only if
no one asks why it's like this. And yes, I know that sounds dramatic but so is pretending.
A locked basement is just storage because the listing said open plan. Maybe I made the map
to large. Maybe I made too many roads. Maybe I turned every scar into something with the code.
I'm looking for the manual. Override something in it. Still alive. Pass the warning lights.
Pass the reasons I provide. I'm more than the fool I find. More than the wires I hide behind.
If you stay beside the noise you might hear my actual voice. It's under settings. Obviously
nested for no reason. I used to rehearse being human like there be a practical exam smile here.
Pause there, ask about there weekend. Do not mention mortality before the second drink I learn
eye contact like a hostage negotiation. Too little suspicious. Too much cult leader. Somewhere
in the middle there is a currently friendship I make plans with the version of me who believes in
calendars. Then actual me arrives wearing yesterday's weather and holding one shoot for
reason. Still under investigation and people say just tell me what you need. As if
me does a clean little package with a bow and a tracking number. Sometimes me does fog.
Sometimes me does chairs. Sometimes me is leaving the room before my face starts making statements.
My mouth cannot legally defend. Sometimes I don't know. Until the damage is sent to receipt.
But I am trying badly with paperwork. I'm looking for the manual. Override something in me.
Still alive. Pass the warning lights. Pass the reasons I provide. I'm more than the fool I find.
More than the wires I hide behind. If you stay beside the noise. You might hear my actual voice.
When I get tired of being both the fire and the evacuation plan. Of saying sorry for the smoke while
still coughing from the room that made it. I know I can be sharp. I have watched my words leave my
mouth wearing boots. I have seen kindness come out crooked because it had to pass through old
machinery. But listen. Not every alarm is manipulation. Not every shot down is refusal.
Not every silence is punishment. Sometimes the system is not ignoring you. Sometimes it is using
everything it has. Not to disappear. So here is the part where I stop pretending.
I know the same thing. I know the loop. I know the exit. I choose. Then accuse of being proof.
I can name the weather. That doesn't mean I have to become a forecast forever.
Maybe the override was never the lever behind glass. Maybe it was smaller.
A breath before the joke attacks. Before the vanishing. A hand on the table. Instead of a case for the defense.
Maybe I say I'm overwhelmed. Before I turn into a fangiture. Maybe you say take your time.
But I'm making time sound like a loan. There's a place between full disclosure and closed doors.
Between here is every wound. And nothing to see here. I'm trying to stand there. Not perfectly.
Not politely but present. I'm looking for the manual overrides. Something in still alive. Pass the warning lights.
Pass the reasons I provide. I'm more than more. I find more than the wires. I'd be hot.
If you stay beside the noise. You might hear my actual voice. I'm looking for the manual overrides.
And not to erase what I survive. Just to choose the door this time. Before they hold the
lawns. This high. So I may require patience. I may arrive strange. I may need to restart the sentence
several times. But I've not broken machine. I am a person. Learning which buttons.
I'm never meant to be pressed. And which ones. Remind.
All the lines.
